propositions: A single criterion's evidence run exhausting its budget currently propagates LLMBudgetExhaustedError and aborts the entire recovery, discarding all gathered evidence and failing the gate with 'bounded evidence recovery also failed'.
The per-criterion evidence loop treats budget exhaustion as a fatal error for the aggregate, when the bound is designed as a per-criterion safeguard that should allow partial evidence preservation.

Recovery must catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, and token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError at the per-criterion level, substitute a content-free placeholder entry marking exhaustion, and continue with remaining criteria.
The finalizer must receive all N criterion evidence entries (including placeholders for exhausted runs) and score exhausted criteria as unverifiable/indeterminate rather than met.
Recovery only fails outright if every criterion's evidence run exhausts or fails; partial evidence from successful evidence runs must reach the finalizer for verdict generation.
